description.value:
When this creature is slain, the creature that landed the killing blow must succeed at a #2-11 Moderate DC# (@Check[type:will|dc:XX]) Will Save or have their body partially turned to stone. This has the effects detailed below, based on tier. The curse lasts until removed.

Special If a creature would be exposed to another instance of this curse, they must make the save again, increasing the affliction stage on a failure. This does not reduce the stage if they succeed.

Tiers 1-3

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (GM's Choice)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, whichever condition they did not gain at Stage 1

Tiers 4-5

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (GM's Choice)

Stage 2 The value of the condition inflicted by Stage 1 increases to 2.

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, (GM's choice, choosing from the two conditions that were not gained at Stage 1)

Stage 4 The value of the condition inflicted by Stage 2 increases to 2.

Stage 5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, whichever condition has not yet been incremented by the curse

Stage 6 The value of the condition inflicted by Stage 5 increases to 2.
